<!--
  The frame of a signed-in app around placeholder content. Axes: topbar (full: across the whole shell, inset:
  over the content column only, none), search (show, hide: the search field of the top bar), sidebar (wide,
  rail, collapsed: the static collapsed state, twolevel: a rail and a section panel, none: the top bar carries
  the links), side (start, end), footer (full, inset, none), content (grid, split, list), frame (window: a
  framed window in a section, page: the whole page). Collapsing the sidebar is a port contract.
-->
<script lang="ts">
import type { ShellNav } from "./dashboard-shell.types";
import type { NavLink } from "./nav-bar.types";

export type DashboardShellProps = {
  id: string;
  title: string;
  level?: 1 | 2;
  nav: ShellNav;
  topbar?: "full" | "inset" | "none";
  search?: "show" | "hide";
  sidebar?: "wide" | "rail" | "collapsed" | "twolevel" | "none";
  side?: "start" | "end";
  footer?: "full" | "inset" | "none";
  content?: "grid" | "split" | "list";
  frame?: "window" | "page";
  landmarkLabel?: string;
};
</script>

<script setup lang="ts">
import { computed } from "vue";
import Block from "../primitives/block/block.vue";
import Box from "../primitives/box/box.vue";
import ShellContent from "../components/shell-content.vue";
import ShellFooter from "../components/shell-footer.vue";
import ShellSidebar from "../components/shell-sidebar.vue";
import ShellTopbar from "../components/shell-topbar.vue";
import { cn, tpl } from "../utils";

const {
  id,
  title,
  level = 2,
  nav,
  topbar = "full",
  search = "show",
  sidebar = "wide",
  side = "start",
  footer = "none",
  content = "grid",
  frame = "window",
  landmarkLabel,
} = defineProps<DashboardShellProps>();
const titleId = computed(() => tpl("{0}-title", id));
</script>

<template>
  <Block
    tag="section"
    :class="(((frame as string) === 'window') ? 'bg-background py-12' : 'bg-background')"
    :id="id"
    :aria-labelledby="(landmarkLabel ? undefined : titleId)"
    data-testid="dashboard-shell"
    :data-topbar="topbar"
    :data-sidebar="sidebar"
    :data-footer="footer"
    :aria-label="landmarkLabel"
  >
    <Box :class="(((frame as string) === 'window') ? 'mx-auto w-full max-w-6xl px-4' : '')">
      <Box
        :class="cn(
          'flex flex-col overflow-hidden bg-background',
          (((frame as string) === 'window') ? 'min-h-160 rounded border border-border' : 'min-h-screen')
        )"
        data-testid="window"
      >
        <ShellTopbar v-if="((topbar as string) === 'full')"
          :nav="nav"
          :links="(((sidebar as string) === 'none') ? 'show' : 'hide')"
          :search="search"
          :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
        />
        <Box :class="cn('flex min-h-0 flex-1', (((side as string) === 'end') ? 'flex-row-reverse' : ''))">
          <ShellSidebar v-if="((sidebar as string) !== 'none')"
            :nav="nav"
            :mode="sidebar"
            :side="side"
            :brand="(((topbar as string) === 'full') ? 'hide' : 'show')"
            :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
          />
          <Box class="flex min-w-0 flex-1 flex-col">
            <ShellTopbar v-if="((topbar as string) === 'inset')"
              :nav="nav"
              :brand="(((sidebar as string) === 'none') ? 'show' : 'hide')"
              :links="(((sidebar as string) === 'none') ? 'show' : 'hide')"
              :search="search"
              :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
            />
            <ShellContent :title="title" :titleId="titleId" :level="level" :content="content" />
            <ShellFooter
              v-if="((footer as string) === 'inset')"
              :nav="nav"
              place="inset"
              :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel"
            />
          </Box>
        </Box>
        <ShellFooter v-if="((footer as string) === 'full')" :nav="nav" :landmarkLabel="landmarkLabel" />
      </Box>
    </Box>
  </Block>
</template>
